name: Uganda
famous_for: 'Pearl of Africa', half of the world's remaining mountain gorillas in Bwindi Impenetrable Forest, source of the Nile in Jinja, and Rwenzori peaks.
tourists: Over 1.5M visitors; famous for Bwindi gorilla tracking, Queen Elizabeth tree-climbing lions, and white-water rafting the Nile in Jinja.
must_know: Winston Churchill famously coined the title 'The Pearl of Africa' in 1908 after marveling at Uganda's magnificent birds, lakes, and vegetation.
fun_fact: Bwindi Impenetrable National Park protects nearly half of the world's entire remaining wild population of endangered mountain gorillas.
